scope: Long-only Router50 research. This file freezes only the corrected U50 router; Base, Meta, MC1, admission and portfolio contracts are not redesigned.

selection.selection_metric: weekly robust mean (Q20--Q80) + 0.5 * mean(weekly Q15, Q10, Q5) of S_router
selection.tie_break: within 0.5% relative of the highest S_stable, prefer the lower-complexity effective tree
selection.comparison_anchor: Baseline P8u under the same corrected weekly utility surface

router.target_utility: max(policy_net_bps - 50, 0), clipped at 300 bps and raised to 0.5
router.row_weight_scheme: positive_125; renormalized within each exact decision timestamp

causality.score_panel: target-free; policy labels are joined only after held scores are persisted
causality.train_labels: resolved before the reserve preceding each held month

promotion: research champion only, pending the required feature-selection and matched downstream Base -> Meta -> Current/BCF MC1 -> portfolio replay.
